# CLI reference

Every command is run as `uv run ableton-remote-script-mcp <command>` from a clone of the
repository. The global option goes before the command:
`uv run ableton-remote-script-mcp --index-dir <folder> lookup class Component`.

## Global options

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--index-dir INDEX_DIR` | Where the per-build JSON index lives (default: $ABLETON_REMOTE_SCRIPT_INDEX, else $XDG_DATA_HOME/ableton-remote-script-mcp/index, else ~/.local/share/ableton-remote-script-mcp/index). |

## `build-index`

Index an installed Live build (default: newest release).

```text
ableton-remote-script-mcp build-index [--app APP] [--no-statements]
```

| Argument | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--app APP` | Path to an Ableton Live .app bundle. |
| `--no-statements` | Leave out the statement summaries of function bodies (then `outline` is unavailable). |

## `list`

List what the index holds.

### `list builds`

The indexed Live builds, and installed ones with no index.

```text
ableton-remote-script-mcp list builds [--json] [--full]
```

| Argument | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Print the query core's answer as JSON. |
| `--full` | The whole answer, not capped at about 4,000 tokens. |

## `import-structure-void`

Fetch Structure Void's reference (the Live module's runtime pages and the framework pages) as a documented source.

```text
ableton-remote-script-mcp import-structure-void [--live LIVE] [--refresh]
```

| Argument | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--live LIVE` | Live major version (default: 12). |
| `--refresh` | Fetch the pages again instead of reusing the local copies. |

## `check-structure-void`

Compare Structure Void's framework pages with a build's index: classes, members, arguments and bases that differ.

```text
ableton-remote-script-mcp check-structure-void [--build BUILD] [--under UNDER] [--json]
```

| Argument | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--build BUILD` | Live build, e.g. 12.4.16 (default: newest indexed). |
| `--under UNDER` | Only this package or module and what is in it, e.g. ableton.v3. |
| `--json` | Print the answer as JSON. |

## `lookup`

Look something up in the index.

### `lookup class`

A class by short, qualified or re-exported name, with inherited members.

```text
ableton-remote-script-mcp lookup class [--build BUILD] [--own] [--member NAME] [--full] [--json] name
```

| Argument | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `name` | The class: short (Component), qualified or re-exported name. |
| `--build BUILD` | Live build, e.g. 12.4.16 (default: newest indexed). |
| `--own` | Only the class's own members, not inherited ones. |
| `--member NAME` | Only this member (repeatable): whether the class has it, own or inherited. |
| `--full` | The whole answer, not capped at about 4,000 tokens. |
| `--json` | Print the query core's answer as JSON. |

## `search`

Classes, modules and members by name or words.

```text
ableton-remote-script-mcp search [--kind KIND] [--limit LIMIT] [--offset OFFSET] [--full] [--build BUILD] [--json] query …
```

| Argument | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `query …` | A name (SessionRing) or words (session ring). |
| `--kind KIND` | Only this kind (member = any class member). One of: `class`, `module`, `member`, `method`, `property`, `classmethod`, `staticmethod`, `function`, `attribute`. |
| `--limit LIMIT` | How many results to show (default: 20). |
| `--offset OFFSET` | Skip this many results: the next page. |
| `--full` | The whole answer, not capped at about 4,000 tokens. |
| `--build BUILD` | Live build, e.g. 12.4.16 (default: newest indexed). |
| `--json` | Print the query core's answer as JSON. |

## `diff`

What changed between two Live builds: packages, modules, classes and members added, removed or changed.

```text
ableton-remote-script-mcp diff [--under UNDER] [--full] [--json] from to
```

| Argument | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `from` | The older build, e.g. 12.4.16. |
| `to` | The newer build, e.g. 12.4.25b1. |
| `--under UNDER` | Only this package or module and what is in it, e.g. ableton.v3 or APC_mini (without it: counts per package). |
| `--full` | With --json: the whole answer, not capped at about 4,000 tokens. |
| `--json` | Print the query core's answer as JSON. |

## `outline`

A Remote Script's classes, Specification, component map, mappings and elements.

```text
ableton-remote-script-mcp outline [--build BUILD] [--all-components] [--section SECTION] [--offset OFFSET] [--full] [--json] script
```

| Argument | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `script` | The Remote Script's folder name, e.g. APC_mini_mk2. |
| `--build BUILD` | Live build, e.g. 12.4.16 (default: newest indexed). |
| `--all-components` | List every name in the v3 component map, not only those the mappings use. |
| `--section SECTION` | Only this section of the outline. One of: `modules`, `create_instance`, `classes`, `specification`, `component_map`, `mappings`, `unknown_components`, `elements`, `components`, `layers`. |
| `--offset OFFSET` | With --section: skip this many items of a long section. |
| `--full` | The whole answer, not capped at about 4,000 tokens. |
| `--json` | Print the query core's answer as JSON. |

## `validate`

Check a Remote Script folder against a Live build's API index.

```text
ableton-remote-script-mcp validate [--build BUILD] [--json] [--full] folder
```

| Argument | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `folder` | The Remote Script's folder (its __init__.py defines create_instance). |
| `--build BUILD` | Live build, e.g. 12.4.16 (default: newest indexed). |
| `--json` | Print the query core's answer as JSON. |
| `--full` | The whole answer, not capped at about 4,000 tokens. |

## `check-names`

Where each API name a script folder uses, or each name given, is known in a Live build: observed, documented, or unknown.

```text
ableton-remote-script-mcp check-names [--names NAME] [--build BUILD] [--json] [--full] folder
```

| Argument | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `folder` | A Remote Script folder (or give --names). |
| `--names NAME` | Names to check instead of a folder: Class, Class.member or a bare name. |
| `--build BUILD` | Live build, e.g. 12.4.16 (default: newest indexed). |
| `--json` | Print the query core's answer as JSON. |
| `--full` | The whole answer, not capped at about 4,000 tokens. |

## `build-stubs`

Write type stubs (.pyi) of a Live build for your editor's Python language server (local only).

```text
ableton-remote-script-mcp build-stubs [--build BUILD] [--out OUT] [--project FOLDER] [--observed-only] [--json]
```

| Argument | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--build BUILD` | Live build, e.g. 12.4.16 (default: newest indexed). |
| `--out OUT` | The folder to write (default: <index dir>/stubs/<build>); a folder of earlier stubs is replaced. |
| `--project FOLDER` | Your script project: the stubs go to FOLDER/stubs, a pyrightconfig.json is created when it has none, and stubs/ is added to its .gitignore when it is in a git repo. |
| `--observed-only` | Leave out the documented members (listener methods, Structure Void's Live members). |
| `--json` | Print the answer as JSON. |

## `mcp`

Run the MCP server over stdio (the lookup commands as tools).

```text
ableton-remote-script-mcp mcp
```

## `install`

Validate a Remote Script folder, then copy it into the User Library.

```text
ableton-remote-script-mcp install [--build BUILD] [--user-library USER_LIBRARY] [--replace] [--no-validate] folder
```

| Argument | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `folder` | The Remote Script's folder. |
| `--build BUILD` | Live build to validate against (default: newest indexed). |
| `--user-library USER_LIBRARY` | The User Library folder (default: $ABLETON_USER_LIBRARY, else ~/Music/Ableton/User Library). |
| `--replace` | Overwrite an installed copy of the same script. |
| `--no-validate` | Copy without validating first. |

## `log`

Tracebacks and messages of Remote Scripts in Live's Log.txt (last session).

```text
ableton-remote-script-mcp log [--script SCRIPT] [--build BUILD] [--log LOG] [--json]
```

| Argument | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--script SCRIPT` | Only this script's tracebacks and messages (its folder name), plus the framework-only tracebacks that may be its own; exit 1 for either. |
| `--build BUILD` | Read the log of this Live build (default: the most recently written log). |
| `--log LOG` | Path to a Log.txt (default: found under $ABLETON_PREFERENCES, else ~/Library/Preferences/Ableton). |
| `--json` | Print the answer as JSON. |

## `rig`

The test rig: play a controller to a Remote Script over a virtual MIDI port (needs the `rig` extra).

### `rig ports`

The MIDI ports the system shows now.

```text
ableton-remote-script-mcp rig ports [--json]
```

| Argument | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Print the answer as JSON. |

### `rig probe`

Open the rig's virtual port, wait until Live sends on it, send one message and show the replies.

```text
ableton-remote-script-mcp rig probe [--name NAME] [--wait WAIT] [--send SEND] [--json]
```

| Argument | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--name NAME` | The virtual port's name (default: ARS Test Rig). |
| `--wait WAIT` | Seconds to wait for Live to connect (default: 120). |
| `--send SEND` | The message to send: `cc\|note\|noteoff <channel 1-16> <number> <value>` or hex bytes (default: cc 13 40 100, the Faderfox UC4's fader 1 in SE17). |
| `--json` | Print the answer as JSON. |

### `rig elements`

The controller model of a script folder: each element's name and MIDI message, as check files name them.

```text
ableton-remote-script-mcp rig elements [--build BUILD] [--json] folder
```

| Argument | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `folder` | The Remote Script's folder. |
| `--build BUILD` | Live build whose index reads the script (default: newest indexed). |
| `--json` | Print the answer as JSON. |

### `rig serve`

Hold the rig's virtual port open (across Live restarts) for `rig run`.

```text
ableton-remote-script-mcp rig serve [--name NAME] [--port PORT] [--profile PROFILE]
```

| Argument | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--name NAME` | The virtual port's name (default: ARS Test Rig). |
| `--port PORT` | The local TCP port clients use (default: 9878). |
| `--profile PROFILE` | A device.yaml whose identity reply the rig sends when Live asks (default: no reply). |

### `rig run`

Run a check file against a script in Live, over `rig serve` or a port of its own; writes checks.result.json beside it.

```text
ableton-remote-script-mcp rig run [--build BUILD] [--name NAME] [--port PORT] [--wait WAIT] [--log LOG] [--no-abletonmcp] [--json] checks
```

| Argument | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `checks` | The check file (checks.yaml). |
| `--build BUILD` | Live build whose index reads the script (default: the check file's, else newest indexed). |
| `--name NAME` | Without `rig serve`: the virtual port's name (default: ARS Test Rig). |
| `--port PORT` | The local TCP port of `rig serve` (default: 9878). |
| `--wait WAIT` | Without `rig serve`: seconds to wait for Live to connect (default: 120). |
| `--log LOG` | The Log.txt to read for `log: clean` (default: the Live build's, else the most recently written). |
| `--no-abletonmcp` | Don't use AbletonMCP even when it runs (state, events and do steps are not checked). |
| `--json` | Print the result as JSON. |

### `rig panel`

A web page of the controller on 127.0.0.1, played through `rig serve` (a parallel view: the driver is in charge).

```text
ableton-remote-script-mcp rig panel [--build BUILD] [--profile PROFILE] [--port PORT] [--http HTTP] [--open] folder
```

| Argument | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `folder` | The Remote Script's folder (a device.yaml beside it gives the layout). |
| `--build BUILD` | Live build whose index reads the script (default: newest indexed). |
| `--profile PROFILE` | The device.yaml to use (default: the one in the script folder, if any). |
| `--port PORT` | The local TCP port of `rig serve` (default: 9878). |
| `--http HTTP` | The panel's local port (default: 9879). |
| `--open` | Open the page in the browser. |

### `rig restart-live`

Quit Live without saving and start it again (only when Live shows just the unsaved test Set; needs the terminal's Accessibility permission).

```text
ableton-remote-script-mcp rig restart-live [--app APP] [--build BUILD] [--title TITLE] [--wait-for WAIT_FOR]
```

| Argument | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--app APP` | The Live app (default: /Applications/Ableton Live 12 Suite.app). |
| `--build BUILD` | Its build, for Log.txt (default: 12.4.16). |
| `--title TITLE` | The test Set's window title (default: Untitled). |
| `--wait-for WAIT_FOR` | Also wait until a script logs this text. |

### `rig abletonmcp`

What the rig reads through AbletonMCP now: its version, the song and each track (for checking reads against what the user sees in Live).

```text
ableton-remote-script-mcp rig abletonmcp [--json]
```

| Argument | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Print the answer as JSON. |
